content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall-kim: sudden spike in streaming gateway 502/504 and client disconnects in eu-central-1 since ~09:04 UTC. Auto-P1.

oncall-kim: oncall here, checking dashboards and recent changes.
luca-sre: seeing a correlated elevation in `http_downstream_timeouts` and `chunked_frame_truncation` logs from the edge proxies. Spike is concentrated on streaming/subscribe and streaming/push routes.
rachel-runtime: runtime metrics show a handful of older model-workers hitting long GC pauses and socket write timeouts during large responses (50-120s sessions). Not a full fleet issue but concentrated on runtimes with version tag `v2023-09-11`.
tom-deploy: no infra deploys in the last 3 hours in eu-central. We did a config rollout for keepalive tuning at 06:30 but only to a small canary.
oncall-kim: can we get a sample trace id and a proxy error line?
luca-sre: sample req id `req_eu_77b`: `proxy: upstream_write_failed: connection reset by peer (EPIPE) while sending chunked trailer`. Also repeated `upstream timed out` in the same window.
rachel-runtime: that matches runtime sockets getting aborted when the proxy closes the connection mid-stream. Hypothesis: aggressive keepalive recycling + older worker GC pauses cause upstream to drop.
oncall-kim: mitigation suggestions?
tom-deploy: immediate safe moves: 1) enlarge proxy upstream timeout from 25s -> 60s for streaming routes, 2) add a temporary connection drain window so older runtimes finish current streams instead of being recycled, 3) scale proxy fleet +15% to absorb burst.
luca-sre: also add a short-term circuit-breaker to downgrade very long-lived streaming sessions to paged mode if they exceed 120s — less ideal but reduces risk of partial truncation for critical customers.
rachel-runtime: I'll tag all `v2023-09-11` workers as `drain=true` and spin up replacement workers with adjusted GC flags (smaller heap/ConcurrentMark settings). This should reduce GC stop-the-world frequency.
oncall-kim: please coordinate and apply in this order: scale proxies, flip upstream timeout, mark old runtimes drain, spin new workers, toggle paged fallback.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Requested autoscale change queued for gateway-euc-01 ASG.
tom-deploy: running config change for upstream timeout (canary 5% -> full roll). Command: ```opsctl rollout-config --service gateway --env eu-central-1 --config timeout_upstream=60s --route-prefix streaming```
cs-alex: CS reporting 12 orgs opened tickets about sudden chat disconnects. Collecting impacted org IDs and severity. We'll need a status update once we have a stable mitigation.
luca-sre: after scaling + timeout flip, 5xx rate dropped from 4.2% -> 1.1% within 6 minutes. Client disconnects decreased but some tail errors remain for sessions >90s.
rachel-runtime: new workers with GC flags deployed to 3 nodes. GC pause p95 reduced from 420ms -> 90ms. Marked older nodes drain=true.
oncall-kim: initiating paged fallback rule (temporary): if stream-duration > 120s or runtime-version in drain list -> route to paged-backend. Tom, implement abort window so clients get a clean closure message when we switch them.
tom-deploy: paged fallback rule deployed as a weighted rule: 10% canary for the first 2 minutes, then 100% for affected sessions. Also pushing `stream_close_reason` telemetry to capture partial-chunk vs client-cancel.
cs-alex: posting interim customer note: short, factual, apologetic, mitigation in progress and retry advice. Will link incident doc.
luca-sre: monitoring thread: pushing metrics every 2m. Current numbers: 5xx 1.0%, stream disconnects down 70% vs peak, long-tail >120s still ~0.2% above baseline.
rachel-runtime: runtime patch stabilized long-running sessions. I'm scheduling a rolling restart over low-traffic window to replace all old workers.
oncall-kim: handoff: I'll keep active pager for 10 more minutes, then pass to @luca-sre for watch. If error rate creeps above 1.5% re-escalate.
incident-bot: :information_source: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 09:32 UTC 5min after mitigation. Postmortem owners assigned: luca-sre (lead), rachel-runtime (runtime), tom-deploy (ops).
cs-alex: customer update sent at 09:34 UTC. Notifying impacted partners privately.
noncall-kim: follow-ups to track: 1) permanent upstream timeout tuning for streaming 2) add streaming-specific healthcheck/heartbeat frames 3) auto-detect runtime GC noise and pre-drain 4) clearer client guidance on retry semantics for streaming.
luca-sre: agreed. I'll start the post-incident doc and I'll include logs, graphs, and the list of affected org IDs. Will schedule PM sync for next-day action items.
noncall-kim: thanks all, handing over watch to @luca-sre. Logging off. :wave:
